reason: The official HM Land Registry PG40 supplement 4 is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from generic title-plan semantics to the specific determined-boundary procedure. It states that the boundary shown for a registered estate is a general boundary unless determined under section 60, and that a determined boundary shows the exact line only when the exact line has already been identified and supported by the required evidence/plan. The verified lineage contains no target-specific determined-boundary register entry or supporting plan, so no canonical parcel geometry/bbox is asserted. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
